messages:
Alex Chen: paging check — we're getting a spike of 5xx and elevated tail latency for inference in eu-west on the dedicated pool. Alert threshold hit 3m ago. Oncall bot (SRE Pager) already paged Jamal.
IncidentBot: Pager triggered for service: inference-dedicated-eu-west, priority: P1. Link: https://warroom.redwood.internal/room/0xA1B2C3
Jamal Ortiz: acked. I’m on my way, joining the war room now. Can someone gather recent autoscale/host metrics and any rollouts?
Maya Patel: I can join as incident lead. Joining war room and will own customer comms. @Priya can you prep a short status page that says "Investigating" and mentions possible throughput impact for Dedicated EU customers?
Priya Singh: on it. Drafting status page: "Investigating increased latency and transient 5xx errors for dedicated inference in eu-west. We are actively investigating and will post updates every 15 minutes." Will push at T+5 unless you want immediate.
Alex Chen: push now — customer calls already coming in from EU partners. Also, set maintenance window to false — we need status page not scheduled maintenance.
Jamal Ortiz: in war room: observed 15% request error rate for m-family models, p90 latency from 400ms -> 6s. Autoscaler shows no recent scale-up; GPU hosts are at 95% memory due to a stuck KV cache process on a subset of pods.
Maya Patel: important — identify the pods with elevated KV. Jamal, can you run the quick query to map pod -> kvsize? Use:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep eu-west
kubectl exec -it pod/<pod-name> -- curl localhost:8080/debug/kvsize
```
Jamal Ortiz: running now. Also rolling a temporary routing rule to route new requests to standby pool in us-west for non-EU legal-restricted customers. Will confirm no data egress issues.
IncidentBot: War room created: https://warroom.redwood.internal/room/0xA1B2C3; channel: #incidents; owner: Maya Patel
Alex Chen: assignment: Maya = incident lead, Jamal = on-call SRE owner for mitigation, Priya = external comms/status page, Alex = liaison to support & sales for high-touch customers.
Priya Singh: pushed initial status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/evue-3124567890 — message set to "Investigating". Will add next update template.
Maya Patel: customer impact assessment — which customers are affected? Alex, run query on tenant headers to list dedicated tenants with > 1% error rate in the last 10m. Put results in the war room doc.
Alex Chen: query ran — top affected tenants: acme-corp (8% errors), atlas-ml (4%), fintech-labs (3%). Uploading snippet to war room.
Jamal Ortiz: found 2 pods with KV cache stuck at 92% of max size, one process showing repeated GC thrash. Plan: safe restart of inference worker process on those pods, one at a time, with route draining to keep latency SLOs. Will run canary restart on pod-a then monitor 2 minutes.
Maya Patel: go for canary. If successful, follow-through to remaining impacted pods. Priya, prepare customer-safe wording: short impact, who we are contacting, ETA for next update. Include link to war room.
Priya Singh: customer notify draft: "We are investigating increased latency and some failed requests for dedicated inference in eu-west. Our engineers have identified a degraded subset of hosts and are performing controlled restarts. We expect to provide an update within 15 minutes. For urgent impact, contact your CSM or reply to this message." Want me to send to top 3 immediately?
Alex Chen: yes, top 3 get immediate notify via email & Zendesk; others via status page. Priya will send; I’ll loop sales/CS.
Jamal Ortiz: canary restart completed on pod-a. Post-restart: p90 latency back to 420ms on that shard, errors dropped to 0.5%. Monitoring other pods now.
Maya Patel: great. Proceed with rolling restarts with 1-min buffer and health checks. Keep status page updated at each milestone (canary success, roll to remaining, mitigation complete).
IncidentBot: Reminder: Run retrospective tag 'INC-3124567890' after incident closed.
Alex Chen: once rollout done, we should roll a short-term hotfix to prevent KV lockups — engineering backlog item assigned. Jamal, can you open a follow-up ticket with logs and root-cause hypothesis?
Jamal Ortiz: will open ticket with traces, pod logs, and commands run. ETA 45m.
Maya Patel: next update in 10m. Everyone on war room, please add direct notes to the war room doc. Priya, send customer emails after next update if still impacted.
Priya Singh: ack. Sending initial emails now to acme-corp, atlas-ml, fintech-labs with incident link and war room contact.
Alex Chen: support thread created for each customer in Zendesk; linking to status page and war room.
Maya Patel: thanks team. Keeping this thread pinned; will post final resolution and postmortem owner once mitigated. :thumbsup:
Jamal Ortiz: rolling restart finished, metrics look healthy across cluster. Errors down to baseline.
Priya Singh: status page updated to "Monitoring — a mitigation was applied and metrics are returning to normal. We will post a full update after investigation."
IncidentBot: Incident marked as mitigated by Maya Patel at 3124568012.
Alex Chen: great work. Postmortem owner: Maya. Assign follow-up actions: hotfix, customer follow-ups, CI for KV cache watch.
Maya Patel: assigned. Closing war room after doc finalized. Thanks everyone. :party_popper:
